title: 420 Ipc
desc: CA Keswani is arrested for bank fraud and forgery. Keswani hires Birbal, a lawyer, to fight his case, but Birbal realises that there's more to it than meets the eye.

title: Nill Battey Sannata
desc: Apeksha hates studying due to financial struggles. Her mother, Chanda, creates a clever plan to motivate her, turning resistance into ambition and learning into empowerment.

title: Coolie No. 1 (1995)
desc: A matchmaker plots to humble arrogant rich man Hoshiyar Chand by having Raju, a coolie, pose as a millionaire, leading to hilarious chaos as Raju tries to win his daughter's hand.

title: Saudagar
desc: The friendship between Veeru and Rajeshwar turns into a bitter rivalry over time. Years later, they confront each other again when their grandchildren fall in love.

title: The Accidental Prime Minister
desc: Amid a tense political climate, economist Manmohan Singh rises to lead India as Prime Minister from 2004 to 2014, navigating challenges with quiet strength and vision.

title: Don - The Chase Begins Again
desc: Vijay, a lookalike of crime lord Don, is recruited to uncover his secrets. When the officer guiding him dies, Vijay is trapped in a deadly maze, struggling to prove his true identity.

title: Indian
desc: Policeman Raj arrests terrorist Wasim Khan and earns praise, but when his father-in-law is mysteriously murdered, Raj is framed and must prove his innocence.

title: Khushi
desc: Khushi and Karan share a fiery love-hate bond, but while playing cupid for their friends, they unexpectedly grow close and end up falling in love with each other.

title: Kya Kool Hain Hum 3
desc: Kanhaiya, an adult film actor in Thailand, falls for Shalu. To win over her traditional father, he fakes a respectable family with help from his quirky co-stars.

title: Great Grand Masti
desc: Three friends meet Ragini in a small town. Her beauty charms them, but soon they realise she brings danger, mystery, and trouble into their lives.

title: Insan
desc: Amjad, an auto-rickshaw driver, lives with his mother in a small tenement. Is his brother Munna who he appears to be?

title: Veere Di Wedding
desc: Kalindi's friends Avni, Sakshi, and Meera reunite for her wedding. Sakshi takes them to Thailand, where they rediscover themselves and confront their personal struggles.

title: Dhadak
desc: Madhu and Parthavi fall in love despite social differences. Families oppose them, forcing the couple to elope, while her father and brother chase relentlessly, testing their bond.

title: Barsaat (1995)
desc: Badal likes his classmate Tina, but her father disapproves. The father falsely gets him arrested, trying to end their relationship before it goes any further.

title: Love Hostel
desc: Amidst bloodshed, deception, and desperate escapes, Jyothi and Ashu elope, prompting her family to hire a ruthless mercenary to hunt them down and end their love.

title: Singh Saab The Great
desc: Singh Saab is an honest and responsible tax officer, but the cunning Bhoodev plots against him. To stand up for what is right, Singh uses a clever and unique plan to teach Bhoodev a strong lesson.

title: Sajan Chale Sasural
desc: After Shyamsunder assumes his wife Pooja died in a flood, he marries Divya. When he discovers Pooja is alive, he scrambles to hide both marriages while juggling between them.
